english.note: Use this for strong or romantic affection, especially in expressions such as 愛你, rather than ordinary preference.

exampleSentences.english: I love you, and I’ll stay by your side no matter what happens.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我愛你，無論發生咩事都會陪住你。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 oi3 nei5 mou4 leon6 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 dou1 wui5 pui4 zyu6 nei5

english.note: Use 愛 only for wanting someone out of romantic love, not for ordinary wanting or blunt sexual lust.

exampleSentences.english: I love you and want to date you.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 oi3 nei5 soeng2 tung4 nei5 paak3 to1
